title: square
description:
Write a function named `square` that takes one `int` and returns that number multiplied by itself.

```cpp
square(4)    // gives 16
square(-3)   // gives 9
```

This task checks the **function** directly, so you do not need a `main`. (You may add one to try things out with Run; the tests ignore it.)
